statements.t: American Place and Chamonix are the Company’s newest casinos; both are expected to continue their improvement as their operations mature.

We believe our temporary facility will continue to grow in the coming quarters, and we look forward to even greater contributions from our permanent American Place casino, which is expected to open approximately two years from now.
These initiatives are in addition to the revenue growth that we have seen – and expect to continue to see – at Chamonix/Bronco Billy’s.”
We will host a conference call for investors today, November 5, 2026, at 4:30 p.m.
We have begun sitework for the permanent gaming facility that we plan to build on adjoining land.

As we expect to open our permanent American Place facility in the second half of 2028, this extension ensures that there will be no gap in tax revenue or employment prior to the opening of our permanent casino facility.

We believe our temporary facility will continue to grow in the coming quarters, and we look forward to even greater contributions from our permanent American Place casino, which is expected to open approximately two years from now.
We do not expect to pay any federal income taxes or receive any federal tax refunds related to our 2026 results, as we anticipate an overall taxable loss for the period.
As the Company’s newest property, Chamonix’s results are expected to continue to improve as its operations mature.
We estimate that between $10 million and $15 million of cash is used in our day-to-day operations.
We also owe $0.6 million related to our finance lease of a hotel at Rising Star, which will be fully paid within the next year.
As required for our gaming licensure at American Place, we have accrued for an interest-free “Reconciliation Payment” that will be due to the IGB over a long-term basis (see Note 8 ).
We currently estimate that a total of $57.1 million will be due to the IGB over the course of six years.

Of the total amount, a discounted value of $41.3 million has been added to the valuation of our Illinois gaming license, while the remaining $15.7 million is expected to be expensed as imputed interest through the maturity of this obligation.
In addition to normal maintenance capital expenditures, we expect to make significant capital investments once we commence construction of the permanent American Place facility.

While we may begin some of the foundation work on the project so as to expedite the opening date, most of the construction of the permanent American Place facility is not expected to begin until funding for such construction is secured.
We expect to internally generate a portion of the needed funds to complete American Place, but we will likely need additional financing.
While there is no certainty that we will be able to do so, we intend to arrange such additional funding concurrent with the refinancing of our existing debt.
Additionally, we may fund various other capital expenditure projects, depending on our financial resources.
No assurance can be given that any of our planned capital expenditure projects will be completed or that any completed projects will be successful.

We evaluate projects based on a number of factors, including profitability forecasts, length of the development period, the regulatory and political environment, and the ability to secure the funding necessary to complete the development or acquisition, among other considerations.

Instead, they are based only on our current beliefs, expectations and assumptions regarding the future of our business, future plans and strategies, projections, anticipated events and trends, the economy and other future conditions.

You should also be aware that while we communicate from time to time with securities analysts, we do not disclose to them any material non-public information, internal forecasts or other confidential business information.
To the extent that reports issued by securities analysts contain projections, forecasts or opinions, those reports are not our responsibility and are not endorsed by us.
